title: Zoned decimal EBCDIC overpunch sign
probable_cause: Faulty Java decodes A-I and J-R correctly but forgets the two zero overpunch characters { (+0) and } (-0).
technical_cause: The EBCDIC overpunch decoding table is incomplete: it handles A-I (+1 to +9) and J-R (-1 to -9) but treats { and } as unknown characters, defaulting them to +0 instead of preserving the intended sign.
fix_sentence: Add the two zero overpunch characters to the decoding table: { is +0 and } is -0.
